How It Works

Three steps.
Full boba experience.

Our patented two-part pouch keeps popping boba and drink sealed separately — preserving freshness until the exact moment you're ready.

Step 01 💥
Burst

Squeeze the bottom to pop the inner seal and combine your popping boba with the drink. The flavor explosion starts right here.

Step 02 ✂️
Rip

Tear the top of the pouch to reveal the built-in collapsible straw. Extend it and you're almost ready to go.

Step 03 🧋
Sip

Unscrew the cap, insert your straw, and sip. Real popping boba, shop-quality flavor — wherever life takes you.

✦ Featured Flavor
Now Available

Strawburst
Lemonade

Bold strawberry popping boba meets a tangy lemonade base — each sealed separately in our two-part pouch. The boba stays firm, the flavor stays bright, and every sip delivers exactly the boba experience you came for. No boba shop required.

Why Burst

Quality meets
convenience.

Current boba options make you choose between quality and convenience. Burst Beverages refuses to compromise — you get both.

🔒

Two-Part Freshness Seal

Popping boba can't survive sitting in liquid. Our patented pouch keeps both components perfectly separated until you burst — no sogginess, ever.

💥

Real Popping Boba

We use juice-filled popping boba — not tapioca — because it's better suited for shelf stability and delivers an authentic burst of flavor every time.

🥤

Built-In Collapsible Straw

No extra accessories needed. The straw is built right into the pouch — compact, ready when you are, and part of the experience from the first rip.

🌍

Shop Quality, Anywhere

Burst closes the gap between the boba shop and a grab-and-go drink. Commute. Gym bag. Beach. Your boba. Your schedule.
